clips.subtitleText: Level 1: Untied tent goes rolling down the mountain while campers chase in vain ⛺💨
Level 2: Sudden storm gust turns giant inflatable bounce house into a tumbleweed 🎪🌪️
Level 3: Freak wind gale flips trampoline clean through suburban wooden fence 💥💨
Level 4: Sudden gale launches power kite pilot 25 feet airborne across field 🪁🚀
Level 5: Tornado wind gust sends porta potties flying 50 feet into the clouds 🚽✈️
